+        """Return the destinations of Linux host-scoped routes, by address family."""
+        reachable = {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+
+        for family, version in (('ipv4', '4'), ('ipv6', '6')):

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '''local 192.168.1.10/24 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host
+local 192.168.0.1 dev lo scope host
+192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host
+broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link
+unreachable 203.0.113.0/24 scope host
+local invalid dev lo scope host
+''', ''),
+        (0, '''local 2001:DB8:0:0::1/64 dev lo
+local ::1 dev lo
+local 2001:db8::1 dev lo scope host
+local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo scope host
+''', ''),
+    ]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64', '2001:db8::1'],
+    }
+    module.run_command.assert_any_call(
+        ['/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host'], errors='surrogate_then_replace')
+    module.run_command.assert_any_call(
+        ['/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host'], errors='surrogate_then_replace')
+    module.warn.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips_query_failure():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, '', '')]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot gather locally reachable IPv4 IPs: route query failed')
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips_command_error():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [OSError('ip unavailable'), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo', '')]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot gather locally reachable IPv4 IPs: route query failed')
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips_without_ipv6():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host', '')
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 1
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot gather locally reachable IPv6 IPs: IPv6 is unavailable')
+
+
+def test_populate_exposes_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    network.get_default_interfaces = Mock(return_value=({}, {}))
+    network.get_interfaces_info = Mock(return_value=({}, {'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+    network.get_locally_reachable_ips = Mock(return_value={'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+
+    assert network.populate()['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector._fact_ids
+
+
+def test_populate_without_ip_command():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).populate() == {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot gather locally reachable IPs: ip command is unavailable')
